Since April 2022 it has run an Android spyware campaign targeting Arabic-speaking users with malicious app updates. The malware 'Skipped_Messenger' uses Firebase as a C2 channel and shares a Firebase project with the Skipped dating app. The report also maps a wider network of dating apps tied to Skipped GmbH and related companies in Germany, Singapore and Dubai.

bdab650a3cc9e1f610f5cc7e04eacba6a932317a.summary: Proofpoint reports on JSSLoader, an initial access loader first observed in September 2019. In June 2021 it returned rewritten from .NET to C++, which the report says could be an effort to evade detection. Most campaigns are attributed to TA543 and use invoice and delivery lures, with TDS landing pages and SharePoint-hosted scripts. A 2019 Griffon payload was linked to TA3546, also known as FIN7. Campaigns have targeted several hundred organizations across many sectors. Indicators and detection signatures are listed.

bd874e6a1da1738d659cfb4bc99e09022d295293.summary: Blog post by Pepe Berba, part 5 of a Linux persistence series, on systemd generators as a boot-time persistence location. It explains the generator directories, walks through a lab example that uses a generator to start a service and overwrite monitoring services, and suggests detection by watching generator directories with auditd, Sysmon, Auditbeat and osquery. The post says the technique has no dedicated sub-technique in MITRE ATT&CK.

bdbf5cdbdeda1e29c4ea9beaa2797aaa71a8f0f4.summary: A news report on TrickBot's Anchor backdoor, which has been ported to Linux as Anchor_Linux. Anchor, first reported in late 2019 as a DNS-based command-and-control framework, is used against high-value targets, including point-of-sale and financial systems. The analysed Linux sample sets up cron-based persistence and carries an embedded Windows TrickBot executable. It copies that executable over SMB to Windows hosts on the same network, where it runs as a Windows service, letting attackers pivot from Linux and IoT devices into corporate networks.
